name: 11-first-guest
title: The First Guest
description: Deploy the reader lab's first user workload onto the live Manchester zone, as gated cmk commands on mgmt-01: one isolated guest network man-guest-01 (10.10.0.0/24, SourceNat, a VLAN from the zone's 500-509 range) and one small CentOS guest guest-01 from the zone's built-in template, then ensure its root volume lands on the production pool rbd-prod (CloudStack's allocator does not guarantee that on its own). Then prove the guest is Running, on its network, at the Small Instance offering, with its volume Ready on rbd-prod. Idempotent via cmk-list probes.
source: Route (a): cmk over Nano's SSH transport. Commands DERIVED from ebooks/matrixclaw-framework scenarios/lab-first-guest.yaml and the adapter's create_network / create_vm (createNetwork -> deployVirtualMachine) in engine/matrixclaw/adapter/live.py, which deployed the live first guest on 2026-07-21 (run mc-20260721-061119). The template, offering and network-offering names are resolved to uuids at call time exactly as the adapter does.
honesty: Three steps change the CloudStack state and are gated; each carries a cmk-list 'already' probe so a re-run skips what exists. The third (pin the root volume to rbd-prod) exists because CloudStack's storage allocator freely uses either cluster pool for an untagged offering, so a fresh deploy lands the volume at random; it stops the guest, migrates the volume and starts it (~1 min), and is skipped once the volume is already on rbd-prod. No secrets are needed here (the guest uses the zone's built-in template and a default offering). Checks are read-only cmk-list commands with exact-match markers so they cannot pass on their own error text. This package REQUIRES package 10 first: the template only exists once the zone and secondary storage have seeded the system VMs, and the network needs the zone.

steps.title: Create isolated guest network man-guest-01 (10.10.0.0/24)
steps.run: zid=$(cmk list zones name=Manchester | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["zone"][0]["id"])') && noid=$(cmk list networkofferings name=DefaultIsolatedNetworkOfferingWithSourceNatService | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["networkoffering"][0]["id"])') && cmk create network name=man-guest-01 displaytext=man-guest-01 zoneid="$zid" networkofferingid="$noid" gateway=10.10.0.1 netmask=255.255.255.0 >/dev/null && echo GUEST-NET-CREATED

steps.title: Deploy guest-01 (CentOS built-in, Small Instance) on man-guest-01
steps.run: zid=$(cmk list zones name=Manchester | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["zone"][0]["id"])') && tid=$(cmk list templates templatefilter=all name="CentOS 5.5(64-bit) no GUI (KVM)" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["template"][0]["id"])') && soid=$(cmk list serviceofferings name="Small Instance" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["serviceoffering"][0]["id"])') && nid=$(cmk list networks name=man-guest-01 | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["network"][0]["id"])') && cmk deploy virtualmachine name=guest-01 displayname=guest-01 zoneid="$zid" templateid="$tid" serviceofferingid="$soid" networkids="$nid" >/dev/null && echo GUEST-DEPLOYED

steps.title: Ensure guest-01's root volume is on rbd-prod
steps.run: vmid=$(cmk list virtualmachines name=guest-01 | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["virtualmachine"][0]["id"])') && vol=$(cmk list volumes virtualmachineid="$vmid" type=ROOT | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["volume"][0]["id"])') && prod=$(cmk list storagepools name=rbd-prod | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["storagepool"][0]["id"])') && cmk stop virtualmachine id="$vmid" >/dev/null && cmk migrate volume volumeid="$vol" storageid="$prod" >/dev/null && cmk start virtualmachine id="$vmid" >/dev/null && echo GUEST-ON-RBD-PROD
steps.already: vmid=$(cmk list virtualmachines name=guest-01 | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["virtualmachine"][0]["id"])') && cmk list volumes virtualmachineid="$vmid" type=ROOT | python3 -c 'import sys,json;v=json.load(sys.stdin)["volume"][0];print("YES" if v.get("storage")=="rbd-prod" else "NO")' | grep -q YES

checks.title: Guest network man-guest-01 present
checks.run: cmk list networks name=man-guest-01 | grep -q '"name": "man-guest-01"' && echo GUEST-NET-OK

checks.title: Guest network CIDR is 10.10.0.0/24
checks.run: cmk list networks name=man-guest-01 | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=sys.stdin.read();n=(json.loads(d)["network"][0] if d.strip() else {});print("GUEST-NET-CIDR-OK" if n.get("cidr")=="10.10.0.0/24" else "cidr="+str(n.get("cidr")))'

checks.title: Guest guest-01 is Running
checks.run: cmk list virtualmachines name=guest-01 | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=sys.stdin.read();v=(json.loads(d)["virtualmachine"][0] if d.strip() else {});print("GUEST-RUNNING-OK" if v.get("state")=="Running" else "state="+str(v.get("state")))'

checks.title: Guest guest-01 is on man-guest-01
checks.run: cmk list virtualmachines name=guest-01 | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=sys.stdin.read();v=(json.loads(d)["virtualmachine"][0] if d.strip() else {});nics=v.get("nic") or [];print("GUEST-ON-NET-OK" if any(x.get("networkname")=="man-guest-01" for x in nics) else "not-on-net")'

checks.title: Guest guest-01 at Small Instance offering
checks.run: cmk list virtualmachines name=guest-01 | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=sys.stdin.read();v=(json.loads(d)["virtualmachine"][0] if d.strip() else {});print("GUEST-OFFERING-OK" if v.get("serviceofferingname")=="Small Instance" else "offering="+str(v.get("serviceofferingname")))'

checks.title: Guest guest-01 root volume Ready on rbd-prod
checks.run: vmid=$(cmk list virtualmachines name=guest-01 | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=sys.stdin.read();v=json.loads(d).get("virtualmachine",[]) if d.strip() else [];print(v[0]["id"] if v else "")') && cmk list volumes virtualmachineid="$vmid" type=ROOT | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=sys.stdin.read();v=(json.loads(d)["volume"][0] if d.strip() else {});print("GUEST-VOL-RBD-PROD-OK" if v.get("storage")=="rbd-prod" and v.get("state")=="Ready" else "vol-on-"+str(v.get("storage")))'
